jobs.name: m1
lines: Last digits. Three times one is three.
Now cross. Two times one is two, plus three times four is twelve. Fourteen.
Write the four, carry the one.
First digits. Two times four is eight, plus the one. Nine.

jobs.name: m2
lines: Numbers between eleven and nineteen? Easy.
Add fourteen to the seven. Twenty-one. Put a zero on the end. Two hundred and ten.
Now multiply the last digits. Four times seven is twenty-eight.
Add them. Two hundred and thirty-eight!

jobs.name: m3
lines: One percent of forty is zero point four.
Ninety-nine percent is all of it, minus one percent.
Forty minus zero point four. Thirty-nine point six!
Your turn: ninety-nine percent of seventy.

jobs.name: m4
lines: One thousand minus four hundred and sixty-seven.
Here's the trick. Take every digit from nine, and the last one from ten.
Your turn: one thousand minus two hundred and eighty-four.
